The Black Road challenge is the hardest challenge in Median XL and consists of five trials, ranging from easy to very difficult. Obtain the favors of the demonlord Kabraxas by overcoming his tests of faith and he will impart some of his dark knowledge unto you.

You can do the five trials in any order, but you need to do all of them if you want the reward. Make sure you have your class charm, which you can obtain from the Kurast 3000 BA uberlevel.

See [[Level ubers#Kurast 3000 BA|Kurast 3000 BA]] for more information.

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/interfaceicons/blackroad_butcher.gif -->

'''1. Trial of Fear'''<br> Overcome your fear of demons by tackling the Butcher in Terror difficulty. Go to The Hole Level 2 and summon him, then kill him. Cube your class charm within 30 seconds after a successful kill.

See [[Summoning ubers#The Butcher|the Butcher]] for more information.

[Class Charm] -> returns [Class Charm] with note of completion (Fear)

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/interfaceicons/blackroad_gold.gif -->

'''2. Trial of Greed'''<br> Material wealth is a sign of demonic corruption. To pass this trial, keep 666,666 gold or more on your character (not your stash), then use the recipe to complete the trial.

[Class Charm] -> returns [Class Charm] with note of completion (Greed)

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/interfaceicons/blackroad_arreat.gif -->

'''3. Trial of Contrition'''<br> Kabraxas is almost impressed with your combat prowess against demons. But how about other humans? To complete this Trial, summon and kill Shaman King Koth on Terror difficulty. Cube the charm within 30 seconds after a successful kill.

See [[Summoning ubers#Assault on Mount Arreat|King Koth]] for more information.

[Class Charm] -> returns [Class Charm] with note of completion (Contrition)

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/interfaceicons/blackroad_robots.gif -->

'''4. Trial of Knowledge'''<br> Obtain untold wisdom by collecting the positronic brains of the five Robot Bosses in Fauztinville in Terror difficulty. Kill the Robot Bosses and collect their Brains.

See [[Level ubers#Fauztinville|Fauztinville]] for more information.

[Class Charm] + Alpha/Beta/Gamma/Delta/Epsilon Brain -> returns [Class Charm] with note of completion (Knowledge)

''Fauztinville is a huge level, and the Robot Bosses are fairly well hidden. You may need to explore the whole level. One of the bosses requires a teleportation ability to access; if you cannot teleport, use an item with charges of a teleportation skill, like the runeword Pax Mystica or the ubercharm Moon of the Spider. A second boss is at the end of a hidden passage, but can be accessed through teleportation as well.''

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/interfaceicons/blackroad_timered.gif -->

'''5. Trial of Blood'''<br> Kabraxas' element is Fire. Sway the [[Amazon]] Islands to your cause by eliminating the priestesses of the [[amazon]] gods of Ice and Lightning. But do it quickly. Kabraxas has no time to waste on bumbling humans like you.

Your targets are Skovos and Lycander, both found in the Tran Athulua uberlevel. Kill them on Terror difficulty. The challenge is that after you kill either one, you have only 30 seconds to kill the other and then cube your class charm. The timer starts ticking down after your first kill. To complete this trial, lead the two priestesses to the same area and kill them quickly, one after the other.

See [[Level ubers#Tran Athulua|Tran Athulua]] for more information.

[Class Charm] -> returns [Class Charm] with note of completion (Blood)

''There is a third Priestess on the level, Philios, Priestess of Hefaetrus. Make sure you kill the correct Priestesses.''

<!-- image: https://modsbylaz.vn.cz/images/interfaceicons/blackroad_done.gif -->

'''Black Road Completion'''<br> After successfully completing all five Challenges, buy four Sacrifical Hearts (sold by magic item vendors) and cube them with your class charm. This will add a number of bonuses and unlock the Level Challenge Skill in your skill tree.

[Class Charm] + Sacrifical Heart x4 -> returns [Class Charm] with added bonuses
